summary: Tumbes stands under Peru's national framework. No region-specific signal was identified for this border department: the sources addressing it do so only through national legislation and national legal analysis, and neither records a Tumbes law, enforcement action, incident or institution. The national assessment applies.
tangentialFactors: No comparison with other Peruvian departments was available, and the sources offer no sub-national breakdown of how the national public-facilities restriction is applied or policed anywhere in the country.
localsOnly: No resident-facing facts specific to Tumbes were sourced. There is no record of a departmental anti-discrimination measure, local police practice toward trans residents, a local health service arrangement, or a local procedure for legal recognition affecting people living in Tumbes.
outOfScopeNotes: Unresolved: whether Tumbes authorities enforce the national restriction on public restroom use, and whether any institution within the department provides gender-marker change or trans healthcare, is not sourced. The two available sources are national in scope, an Infobae Perú report of 20 February 2025 and an IDEHPUCP legal analysis of 15 April 2025, and carry no Tumbes-specific content.
